function.name: check_agent_availability_inbound
function.description: Checks whether any live human agent from the call team is currently available to take a transferred call. Takes no parameters. Returns anyAvailable (true/false), availableCount, the list of available agents, and the full roster with each agent's status. Call it BEFORE offering to transfer the caller to a team member: if anyAvailable is false, do not attempt the transfer — offer to schedule a callback instead.
